doc.name: G — 30s emotional testimonial arc set in a old market, hopeful in tone, an animal companion, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: emotional testimonial arc set in a old market, hopeful in tone
Hero: an animal companion
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the emotional testimonial arc set in an old market, hopeful in tone form, built around an animal companion.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a 90-degree orbit arcing camera-left around the subject in Act 1 against a snap zoom in followed by a settle in Act 3 — while holding the a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second emotional testimonial arc set in an old market, hopeful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same animal companion.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject, shot on a 24-70mm zoom at the long end at f/5.6, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill; grade as a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality

config.system_prompt:

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same animal companion.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a snap zoom in followed by a settle, shot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/5.6, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a projected gobo throwing a broken pattern across the background; grade as a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second emotional testimonial arc set in an old market, hopeful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same animal companion.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a top-down descent onto a flat plane, shot on a 200mm compression telephoto at f/2.8, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs
